scenario: Maya and Theo are flatmates catching up in the kitchen on a Sunday evening. Theo has just come back from a camping weekend that went badly wrong, and Maya spent hers at home failing to assemble a bookshelf. They tease each other, drift onto food and plans for next weekend, and end up half-agreeing to try camping together.

A.name: Maya
A.summary: Chatty, quick to react, loves a story.
A.speaking_style: fast, lots of backchannels and eager interruptions

B.name: Theo
B.summary: Dry humour, tells long stories with detours.
B.speaking_style: pauses mid-sentence to find words, holds the floor

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Oh, you're back! How was the camping thing?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Honestly? <pause 0.6> It was kind of a disaster. So we get there on Friday, right, and the campsite is, um <pause 0.8> it's basically a swamp. Like, the whole field is underwater.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Oh no.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: mhm

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: And Sam had packed the tent, supposedly, but when we open the bag there are no poles. Just the tent and like <pause 0.7> four pegs.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: No poles? So what did you do, just sleep in the car?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Pretty much, yeah.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Three grown men in a hatchback. I don't think I slept at all.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: That is so bad. I'm sorry, but that's hilarious.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Yeah, yeah, laugh it up. What did you do, anyway?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Okay, so, mine was also a disaster, but a smaller one. I bought that bookshelf, the tall one, and I thought, you know, how hard can it be? <pause 0.9> And it took me the entire Saturday.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Right.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: And then at the end there were, like, six screws left over, and the whole thing kind of leans.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Leans which way?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Towards the bed.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Okay, that's, um <pause 0.7> that's actually a safety issue, Maya.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: It's fine, it's fine, I

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: No, I'm serious, I'll look at it tomorrow. I've got the proper drill, we can just, uh, take the back panel off and redo the top bit.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Okay.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Fine. Thank you. I'll make dinner, then. Deal?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Deal.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: What are you making? Because if it's that lentil thing again <pause 0.6> I might need to renegotiate.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Excuse me, the lentil thing is amazing. But no, I was thinking tacos.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Okay, tacos I can do. Tacos are good. You know what we should do though, next weekend, if the weather's okay

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: If you say camping, I'm leaving.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Hear me out. <pause 0.8> A proper campsite, with a toilet block and, um, actual dry ground. And I check the poles myself.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Ha.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Hmm.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Is there a pub nearby?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: There is a pub <pause 0.5> within walking distance. I looked it up on the drive back, because I knew you'd ask.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: uh-huh

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Okay. Okay, I'm, like, sixty percent in. Ask me again after tacos.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Sixty percent. I'll take it. I'm gonna go shower, I still smell like a swamp.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Yeah, you really do.
